title: DroneLab virtual-build AERO DATASET v1 (aero/CFD stage -> flight-sim stage)
description: Output contract of research/aero/stork_aero.py (low-order) and cfd_case.py (CFD calibration points). Units SI; angles in *_deg keys are degrees, all derivatives are PER RADIAN; rate derivatives are non-dimensionalised with p*b/2V, q*c/2V, r*b/2V. Frame for positions: structural (origin wing-root LE on centreline, +X aft, +Y right, +Z up) - identical to sim/schema/aircraft_model.schema.json and geom/stork.yaml. Force/moment coefficients: stability axes, standard flight-mechanics signs (CL up, CD along -V, CY right, Cl right-wing-down +, Cm nose-up +, Cn nose-right +), referenced to reference.S_m2, b_m (Cl, Cn), c_m (Cm), about reference.moment_ref_m. Control deflections positive TRAILING-EDGE-DOWN for every physical surface (V-tail panel: towards its lower/outboard side). Names of derivatives (CL0, CLa, CLq, CLmax, alpha_stall_deg, CD0, oswald, CD_beta2, Cm0, Cma, Cmq, Cmadot, CYb, CYp, CYr, Clb, Clp, Clr, Cnb, Cnp, Cnr) and of surfaces (aileron_left, ...) are IDENTICAL to sim/schema/aircraft_model.schema.json so 'derivatives' and 'surfaces[].derivatives_per_rad' can be copied verbatim. JSBSim mapping: alpha_tables[V] -> <function name='aero/coefficient/CL'> table of aero/alpha-deg (optionally 2-D with Re/velocity breakpoints from the several V entries); beta_table -> CY/Cl/Cn(beta) tables; derivatives -> product functions (e.g. Clp * pb/2V). ArduPilot SITL (SIM_Plane / JSON backend) mapping: CLa->'CLa', CL0->'CL0', CD0->'CD0', Cma->'Cma', Cm0->'Cm0', Cmq->'Cmq', CYb->'CYb', Clb->'Clb', Clp->'Clp', Clr->'Clr', Cnb->'Cnb', Cnp->'Cnp', Cnr->'Cnr', aileron Cl -> 'Cl_da' (use right-minus-left/2 for the antisymmetric mode), V-tail: elevator mode Cm_de = Cm(rv_left)+Cm(rv_right), rudder mode Cn_dr = Cn(rv_right)-Cn(rv_left) with SIM_Plane's sign convention checked per-model.

alpha_table.description: Longitudinal static data at beta = 0, controls neutral, at one airspeed (Reynolds number). CD is the TOTAL drag (induced + profile + fuselage/tail/booms + excrescence + extras). Should span -20..+30 deg; post-stall from AeroSandbox 360-deg model (low confidence beyond ~CLmax+5 deg).

CD_extra.description: Constant extra CD from items not modelled (VTOL motors, stopped props ...).

control_derivs.description: Increment of TOTAL aircraft coefficients per radian of this surface's deflection (+ TE down).

CD_abs.description: Drag increment per |rad| (induced from AVL Trefftz + 0.02/rad viscous allowance).

geometry.description: Path / revision of the parametric geometry used.

alpha_tables.description: Keyed by airspeed string (e.g. '14.0'). Several speeds give the Reynolds-number dependence (important at Re 1-3e5).

derivatives.description: Recommended linear set (same names as sim schema).

derivatives_by_source.description: Raw per-tool values (aerobuildup, avl, asb_vlm, cfd ...) for traceability.

polar_fit.description: CD = CD0 + k (CL - CL_minD)^2 fitted over the attached-flow range; e_eff = 1/(pi AR k).

cfd_points.description: High-fidelity calibration points from cfd_case.py (half-model, symmetry plane).
